User Story:
As a staff member,
I want to log in with my username and password,
so that I can access the system with my assigned role.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the login page,
When I enter a valid username and password and submit,
Then I receive a JWT token and am redirected to my role-specific dashboard.

User Story:
As a logged-in user,
I want to be automatically redirected to my role-specific dashboard after login,
so that I immediately see the tools relevant to my role.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I have just logged in,
When the login succeeds,
Then I am redirected to /admin, /doctor, /nurse, or /patient depending on my role.

User Story:
As a logged-in user,
I want to log out,
so that my session is cleared and no one else can access my account from this device.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in,
When I click the logout button,
Then my token and session data are removed and I am redirected to the login page.

User Story:
As a logged-in user,
I want my session to expire after 6 hours,
so that unattended sessions do not remain open.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in,
When 6 hours have passed since login,
Then my JWT token is no longer accepted and I am required to log in again.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to see a list of all patients with their name, gender, and CPR number,
so that I can quickly find who I am looking for.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as a nurse or doctor,
When I open the patients tab,
Then I see a table listing all patients with first name, last name, gender, and CPR number.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to filter the patient list by first name, last name, gender, or CPR number,
so that I can narrow down large lists efficiently.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the patient list,
When I type in a filter field for any column,
Then the list updates to show only patients matching the entered value.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to sort the patient list by any column,
so that I can organize the view the way I prefer.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the patient list,
When I click a column header,
Then the list is sorted by that column in ascending order, and clicking again sorts it descending.

User Story:
As a nurse,
I want to click on a patient to open their detail page,
so that I can see their full visit history and treatments.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the patient list,
When I click the View button on a patient row,
Then I am taken to that patient's detail page at /patients/{id}.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to create a new patient record with their first name, last name, gender, and CPR number,
so that new patients are registered in the system.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as admin,
When I fill in the patient form and submit,
Then a new patient record is created and appears in the patient list.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to edit an existing patient's details,
so that records stay accurate over time.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as admin,
When I edit a patient's fields and save,
Then the updated values are reflected in the patient list and detail page.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to delete a patient record,
so that outdated or incorrect entries can be removed.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as admin,
When I delete a patient,
Then that patient no longer appears in the list.

User Story:
As a patient,
I want to log in and see only my own record,
so that my personal data is protected from other patients.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as a patient,
When I open my dashboard,
Then I see only my own name, gender, and CPR number and cannot access other patients' data.

User Story:
As a nurse,
I want to open a patient's detail page and see all their room bookings alongside the treatments given during each visit,
so that I have a complete picture of the patient's care history.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on a patient's detail page,
When the page loads,
Then I see a list of room bookings, each with the treatments that occurred within that booking's time window.

User Story:
As a nurse,
I want to see the full location of each visit,
so that I know exactly where the patient was treated.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on a patient's detail page,
When I look at a room booking entry,
Then I can see the building name, floor name, and room name for that booking.

User Story:
As a nurse,
I want to see treatments that are not linked to any room booking listed separately,
so that no treatment is missed in the overview.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on a patient's detail page,
When the patient has treatments outside any booking time window,
Then those treatments appear in an Other Treatments section.

User Story:
As a nurse,
I want to initiate a treatment for a patient by selecting the patient, entering a description, and optionally selecting a medication and dose,
so that treatment records are created in the system.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Give Treatment tab,
When I select a patient, enter a description, optionally select a medication and dose, and submit,
Then the form proceeds to the doctor sign-off step.

User Story:
As a nurse,
I want to be required to get a doctor's sign-off before a treatment is recorded,
so that treatments are always medically authorized.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I have filled in the treatment form,
When I submit it,
Then I am prompted to enter a doctor's username and password before the treatment is saved.

User Story:
As a nurse,
I want the treatment, prescription, and stock deduction to all happen at once when a treatment is given,
so that records stay consistent and nothing is missed.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the nurse submits a treatment with a medication and the doctor approves,
When the request is processed,
Then a treatment record, a prescription record, and a stock deduction are all created in a single atomic transaction.

User Story:
As a doctor,
I want to see all treatments in my dashboard,
so that I have an overview of ongoing care.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as a doctor,
When I open the Treatments tab,
Then I see a list of all treatments with patient, description, and time.

User Story:
As a doctor,
I want to edit a treatment's patient, description, or time directly from the list,
so that I can correct errors without leaving the page.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the treatments list,
When I click edit on a treatment,
Then I can update the patient, description, and time inline and save the changes.

User Story:
As a doctor,
I want to delete a treatment,
so that incorrectly created records can be removed.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the treatments list,
When I click delete on a treatment and confirm,
Then that treatment is removed from the list.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to view all prescriptions in the system,
so that I have a full audit trail of what has been prescribed.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as admin,
When I open the Prescriptions tab,
Then I see a list of all prescriptions with medication, treatment, prescribed-by staff, and dose.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to create, edit, and delete prescriptions manually,
so that records can be corrected if needed.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Prescriptions tab,
When I create, edit, or delete a prescription and save,
Then the change is reflected immediately in the list.

User Story:
As a nurse,
I want a prescription to be automatically created when I give a treatment with a medication,
so that I do not have to enter it separately.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a nurse gives a treatment with a medication selected,
When the doctor approves and the transaction completes,
Then a prescription record is automatically created linked to that treatment.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to create a new medication with its name, generic name, brand, form, strength, category, and description,
so that the medication catalog stays complete.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Medications tab,
When I fill in all medication fields and submit,
Then the new medication appears in the catalog and is selectable when giving treatments.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to edit and delete medications in the catalog,
so that the list stays accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Medications tab,
When I edit or delete a medication and save,
Then the catalog reflects the updated or removed entry.

User Story:
As any logged-in user,
I want to see the list of available medications when giving a treatment,
so that I can select the right one.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am filling in the Give Treatment form,
When I open the medication selector,
Then I see all medications from the catalog listed as options.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to view current stock levels for all medications,
so that I know what is available before planning treatment.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as nurse or doctor,
When I open the Medication Storage tab,
Then I see each medication listed with its current stock amount.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to edit the stock amount for any medication,
so that stock levels reflect deliveries or corrections.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Medication Storage tab as admin,
When I change the amount for a storage entry and save,
Then the updated stock level is shown immediately.

User Story:
As a nurse,
I want to report missing medication by selecting the storage entry, entering the quantity missing, and a timestamp,
so that losses are tracked and stock is automatically reduced.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Medication Storage tab,
When I submit a missing medication report with a quantity and timestamp,
Then the stock amount is reduced by that quantity and the report is saved.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to view and manage all missing medication reports,
so that I can investigate and follow up on losses.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as admin,
When I open the missing storage section,
Then I see a list of all reports with medication, quantity missing, and timestamp, and I can edit or delete them.

User Story:
As any visitor,
I want to search for medicine prices by product name,
so that I can look up publicly available price information.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the medicine price search page,
When I enter a product name and search,
Then I see a list of matching medicines from the external Danish medicines API.

User Story:
As any visitor,
I want to search for medicines by active ingredient,
so that I can find alternatives to a specific branded product.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the medicine price search page,
When I enter an ingredient name and search,
Then I see all products containing that ingredient.

User Story:
As any visitor,
I want to click on a search result to see detailed product information,
so that I can compare options.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I see a list of medicine search results,
When I click on a product,
Then I see its full details including pricing information.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to book a room for a patient by selecting the room, patient, start time, and end time,
so that the patient has an assigned room during their stay.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Book Room tab,
When I fill in the room, patient, start time, and end time and submit,
Then a new room booking is created and appears in the bookings list.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want the system to prevent me from booking a room that is already occupied during the requested time,
so that double-bookings do not happen.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a room already has a booking for a time period,
When I try to book the same room with an overlapping time,
Then the system rejects the booking and shows a conflict error.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to allow a new booking to start exactly when another ends,
so that room transitions are handled smoothly.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a room booking ends at time T,
When I create a new booking for the same room starting at time T,
Then the booking is accepted without a conflict error.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to edit an existing room booking,
so that I can correct dates or change the room assignment.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the room bookings list,
When I edit a booking and save,
Then the updated details are reflected in the list and conflict checking excludes the booking being edited.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to delete a room booking,
so that cancelled stays are cleared from the schedule.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the room bookings list,
When I delete a booking,
Then it is removed from the list and that room becomes available for that time slot.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to create a new staff member with their first name, last name, and role,
so that new employees are registered in the system.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Staff Management tab,
When I fill in the staff form and submit,
Then the new staff member appears in the staff list.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to edit and delete staff records,
so that the staff list stays current.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Staff Management tab,
When I edit or delete a staff record and save,
Then the list reflects the change.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to filter and sort the staff list,
so that I can find specific people quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the staff list,
When I enter a filter value or click a column header,
Then the list filters or sorts accordingly.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to create, edit, and delete departments,
so that the organizational structure of the hospital is reflected in the system.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Departments tab,
When I create, edit, or delete a department and save,
Then the change is immediately reflected in the department list.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to create, edit, and delete shifts with a start and end time,
so that working hours are tracked in the system.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Shifts tab as admin,
When I create, edit, or delete a shift and save,
Then the shift list updates to reflect the change.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to view the shift schedule filtered by a date range,
so that I can check upcoming or past shifts.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Shifts tab,
When I enter a from-date and to-date and apply the filter,
Then only shifts within that date range are shown.

User Story:
As a nurse or doctor,
I want to sort the shift list by start or end time,
so that the schedule is easy to read.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the shift list,
When I click the start time or end time column header,
Then the list is sorted by that column in ascending or descending order.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to register a new user account linked to a staff member,
so that staff can log into the system.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Users tab,
When I enter a username, password, and select a staff member and submit,
Then the new user account is created and the staff member can log in with those credentials.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to change a user's password,
so that I can help staff who have lost access.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Users tab,
When I enter a new password for a user and save,
Then the user can log in with the new password and no longer with the old one.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to delete a user account,
so that former staff can no longer log in.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Users tab,
When I delete a user account,
Then that account is removed and login with those credentials is no longer possible.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to view the full location hierarchy,
so that I know what rooms are available for booking.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am logged in as admin,
When I open the location view,
Then I see all buildings with their floors and rooms listed.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to create, edit, and delete floors,
so that the building structure can be managed.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am viewing the location hierarchy,
When I create, edit, or delete a floor and save,
Then the floor list updates to reflect the change.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to assign staff members to treatments,
so that it is recorded which staff were involved in a patient's care.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Treatment Staff tab,
When I select a treatment and a staff member and submit,
Then the assignment is saved and visible in the treatment staff list.

User Story:
As an admin,
I want to edit and remove treatment-staff assignments,
so that records stay accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am on the Treatment Staff tab,
When I edit or delete an assignment and save,
Then the list reflects the updated or removed assignment.
